# Are mortgage points worth buying?

> Free mortgage points calculator: break-even month, return on the points, how far ahead or behind you are when you sell or refinance, and the chance you finish ahead. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
